title: [BUG] Claude Code not connecting to api.anthropic.com
body:

## Bug Description
I have been unable to connect to api.anthropic.com

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to any directory in WSL as first command
2. Type in "claude" to open the Claude CLI from the directory
3. See message imaged below that shows api is unavailable. Connecting via browser also does the same.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6f5bb8c9-2348-4c7a-ad55-17db0712cee1)

## Actual Behavior
